a.speaker: engineer
a.text: Mind the cables. This floor is my problem. The rest of the tower can wait.

skye.speaker: engineer
skye.text: She was in this week, finishing the latest renders for the new Taku project. Then she stopped coming. Nobody tells me why. I just keep the cables alive.

music.speaker: engineer
music.text: Three albums on that wall: Adventures in Weirdness, Audio Chaos and B-Sides. She built about 189 of her own instruments in Reason, too. Nobody needs that many. She did.

end.speaker: engineer
end.text: The volume’s already too loud. That’s how she likes it.
